source: ERA5 reanalysis (contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information) via Open-Meteo (archive-api, models=era5, CC-BY 4.0), daily maximum 2 m temperature
smoothing: 21-day circular mean, sampled at 52 week centres
format: node 'lat,lon' -> [elevation_m, 52 weekly normals in tenths of °C]
